contradictions.notes: Design 16 section 3 puts context retrieval, routing thresholds and repair heuristics in class B; the code classifies router_policy_ref and context_policy_ref as class A by field. Resolved in the design by D-096: component-level classes following design 16 (normative).

current_behavior.notes: Only the IMPLEMENTER prompt bundle is variable; context/verification/budget refs share an unread policy record; effort never passed; analysis is non-inferiority only; trials use a planner stand-in.

invariants.notes: 3.0.0 schemas unchanged; class C not a candidate surface; evaluator changes qualified alone; proposer cannot approve; safety failure fails; missing data inconclusive; no adaptive peeking.

source_of_truth.notes: Design 16 is normative; DECISIONS.md D-088..D-095 are active; the evolution state machine is contracts/state-machines.json.

system_boundary.notes: Meta-harness gates, evaluation service, corpus ACL and release pointer stay the boundary; drivers run in containers (D-073, D-091).

terminology.notes: Cell = model-profile (provider_model_id, reasoning_profile); component, manifest, stage, informative task defined in spec.md Terms.

verifier.notes: Verifier profile v2, targeted pytest per slice, corpus fairness check, CI.
